No Foaming Action
Agent:
“I'm sorry to hear that you're not getting the foaming action you expected. Let me walk you through a few quick steps to help activate the product properly.”
Step 1 – Reduce Excess Water
“First, please give the toilet a flush to clear out some of the standing water in the bowl. Too much water can dilute the formula and prevent it from foaming properly.”
Step 2 – Use One Full Packet
“Next, please make sure you're using one full packet for each application. Using only part of a packet may result in weak or little to no fizzing.”
Step 3 – Allow Time to Activate
“Once you've sprinkled the full packet into the toilet bowl, please leave it undisturbed for about 5 to 10 minutes. This gives the formula enough time to fully activate and work.”
Step 4 – Warm Water Boost
“If you'd like to give it an extra boost, you can follow it with warm, not boiling, water. This may help the reaction along, especially if the environment is cooler.”
Agent – Closing:

“Once you've completed those steps, you should be able to see more foaming action from the cleaner. Please let me know how it goes, and we'll be happy to assist further if you're still experiencing an issue.”

Product Clumping

Agent:
“I understand your concern about the powder being clumped together. No worries — let me explain why this can happen and what you can do.”

Step 1 – Reassure the Customer
“The good news is that clumping does not affect the cleaning power of the product. The formula and ingredients remain the same, so it will work the same whether the powder is loose or slightly clumped.”


Step 2 – Break Up the Clumps
“You can simply give the packet a gentle shake or tap to loosen the powder. Once it comes into contact with water, it will activate and foam as intended.”


Step 3 – Proper Storage
“To help prevent the powder from clumping again, we recommend keeping the unused packets sealed tightly and stored in a cool, dry place. Exposure to humidity during transit or storage can sometimes cause the powder to clump.”


Agent – Closing:
“So, the clumping is mainly a cosmetic change in the powder's texture and does not indicate a product quality issue. You can still expect the same cleaning results from the product.”
Residue Left Behind
Agent:
“I understand your concern about some powder being left behind after using theToilet Cleaner. Let me walk you through a few steps that can help ensure a clean finish.”
Step 1 – Use One Full Packet

“First, please make sure you're using one full packet per application. Using more than one packet at a time can leave some powder undissolved. One packet is the recommended amount for a full cleaning.”
Step 2 – Rinse After the Foam Works

“After sprinkling the powder into the bowl, allow the foam to work for about 5 to 10 minutes. Once the wait time is complete, you can flush the toilet twice or rinse with warm, not hot, water. This helps dissolve any remaining powder and wash it away.”
Step 3 – Light Scrub if Needed
“If you still notice a small amount of residue after flushing, you can use a toilet brush or sponge for a quick, light scrub, followed by a final rinse.”

opening a window, running an exhaust fan, or leaving the bathroom door open before and during application makes a big difference in managing the fragrance strength.

the fragrance intensity peaks when the foam first activates and fades significantly after flushing.

Agent:

“For older or stubborn stains, you can let the foam sit for up to 30 minutes. This gives the formula more time to work on the buildup.”
Step 2 – Reapply if Needed

“If the stain is still visible after the first treatment, you can repeat the process once or twice more over the next few days. Some older stains may require multiple treatments before you see the full results.”
Step 3 – Light Scrub After Soaking
“After allowing the product to sit, use a soft-bristled toilet brush or sponge to gently scrub the area. This can help lift the buildup that the foam has already loosened.”
Clogged Toilet
Agent:
“I understand your concern about the toilet draining slowly after using the product. Let me walk you through a few steps that may help clear any remaining product or buildup.”
Step 1 – Use One Full Packet Only
“First, please make sure you're using only one full packet per application. Using more than one packet at a time can create thicker buildup that may take longer to dissolve.”
Step 2 – Flush With Warm Water

“After allowing the foam to work for the recommended sit time, flush the toilet or rinse with warm, not boiling, water. The warm water can help break down any thick or slow-moving remnants and help clear them away.”
Step 3 – Avoid Mixing Products
“Also, please avoid mixing X-All Toilet Cleaner with bleach or other cleaning products. Mixing cleaners can cause unwanted reactions or clumping, which may affect how easily the product clears.”

First, let’s make sure the tablet is fully dissolved. When preparing the solution, please use warm, not hot, water, shake the bottle really well, and let it sit for about 15 to 20 minutes. The solution should be completely clear without any visible particles. If there are still undissolved pieces, the solution may not be at its full strength.

The next and most important step is the contact time. After spraying the product onto the surface, please let it sit for a full 2 minutes before wiping. The formula needs that time to chemically break down grease, grime, and buildup. Spraying and immediately wiping is one of the most common reasons you may not see the expected results.

When you're ready to wipe, I recommend using a clean microfiber cloth rather than a paper towel. Wipe in one direction to help lift the dissolved grime and prevent residue or streaks from being left behind.

And if you're dealing with heavy or baked-on buildup, you can do a double pass. Start with one application to break down the buildup, wipe it away, then do a light second spray and wipe again.

Following these steps should help you get much better results from the Splash Spray.
Product Damaged Surface

Agent: I’m sorry to hear that you noticed a mark or change on the surface. I’d be happy to help you troubleshoot that. In many cases, what looks like surface damage can actually be removable residue or a temporary reaction that can be reversed.

First, let’s check if the Splash Spray tablet was completely dissolved before use. If there were any undissolved particles, they can sometimes leave temporary marks, especially on polished stone or sealed wood. Please try wiping the affected area with a clean, damp cloth, then immediately dry it with a dry microfiber towel.

If the affected area is marble or natural stone and you're noticing a dull or hazy spot, gently buff the area with a dry microfiber cloth. These surfaces can be more sensitive to cleaning products, so we recommend spraying and wiping within 1–2 minutes and making sure the surface is completely dry afterward.

If the mark is on a wood surface and appears cloudy or white, this can often be a moisture reaction with the finish rather than permanent product damage. Try wiping the area with a barely damp cloth and immediately drying it. In many cases, the mark can fade within 24–48 hours as the moisture evaporates.

Splash Spray is made with non-toxic, natural ingredients and is designed for use on virtually all hard surfaces. The key is making sure the tablet is fully dissolved, using the appropriate contact time for the surface, and drying the surface completely after cleaning.

I completely understand your concern about the scent. Splash Spray is made with natural, non-toxic ingredients, and the dissolving process can sometimes produce a stronger scent than the finished solution. The scent should mellow significantly once the solution has settled.

To help reduce the initial smell, I recommend letting a freshly mixed solution sit for about 30–60 minutes before using it. The scent is usually strongest immediately after dissolving and should fade as the solution settles.

Also, while warm water helps the tablet dissolve, it can make the initial scent more noticeable. Once the solution cools down to room temperature, the scent should become much milder.

For best results, we also recommend making a fresh bottle every 1–2 weeks. Solutions that sit for too long can develop a stale or musty smell as the natural ingredients settle.

Lastly, you only need to use a light, even spray. If the scent is still lingering on the surface for more than a few minutes after wiping, you may be using more product than necessary.
Skin Allergy or Irritation

If skin irritation, rash, or respiratory sensitivity occurs, discontinue use right away. If symptoms persist or worsen, consult a healthcare professional.

If the product gets in eyes, rinse thoroughly with cool water for 15 minutes. If irritation continues after rinsing, see a healthcare professional.

A few things worth knowing about the formula and safe use:

1. Splash Spray is made with natural, non-toxic ingredients. That said, even natural ingredients — including plant-based surfactants — can cause sensitivity in some individuals, just as some people react to substances like aloe, citrus, or lavender. Individual sensitivities vary.
2. Wear household cleaning gloves during extended cleaning sessions. This is a good practice with any cleaning product, especially for sensitive skin.
3. Avoid inhaling the spray mist directly. Hold the bottle 6–8 inches from the surface and spray away from the face. In smaller enclosed spaces like a shower or bathroom, make sure there’s adequate ventilation.
Spray Bottle Leaking

The cleaning formula is in the tablets, not the bottle — the tablets work in any standard spray bottle you already have. If the included bottle is giving trouble, the solution can be transferred to any household spray bottle.

Here are a few things that usually fix common bottle issues:

1. Nozzle clogging: remove the spray head and rinse under warm running water for 30 seconds. Clear the nozzle opening with a pin or toothpick. The most common cause is undissolved tablet particles — make sure the tablet is fully dissolved (warm water, 15–20 minute wait) before spraying.
2. Drips instead of spraying: twist the nozzle head to confirm it’s in spray mode, not off or stream. If it still drips after confirming the setting, the internal mechanism may be damaged.
3. Leaking from the base or seal: check that the spray head is threaded on straight and tightened fully. Cross-threading can create gaps. If the leak is from the bottle body itself, it was likely damaged in transit.

The bottle is a convenience — the real product is the tablets. Let me know if you have any other questions.
Tablet Won't Dissolve

1. Use warm tap water — not cold, not boiling: warm water dissolves the tablet significantly faster and more completely. Cold or room-temperature water is the most common reason tablets don’t fully dissolve.
2. Drop the tablet in first, then fill with warm water: this ensures the tablet is fully submerged from the start.
3. Shake vigorously for 30 seconds, then let it sit for 15–20 minutes: after the wait, give it another good shake. The solution should be completely clear with no visible particles.
4. If the tablet arrived as powder or crumbles, it’s still fully usable: pour the contents into the bottle and follow the same warm water + shake + wait process. Powder actually dissolves faster than an intact tablet.
5. If the nozzle is clogging: undissolved particles are usually the cause. Remove the spray head, rinse under warm running water for 30 seconds, and clear the nozzle opening with a pin or toothpick. Making sure the tablet is fully dissolved before spraying prevents future clogs.

Made the Proble Worse

The product is designed to break down and loosen buildup that has accumulated in a machine over time. In machines with significant buildup, the first cleaning can dislodge grime that was previously stuck in hidden areas like pipes, gasket folds, and drum crevices. This can temporarily make things look or smell worse before they get better — it’s a sign the product is working.

Here’s what we recommend:

1. Run a second tablet immediately on another empty hot cycle: this will flush out the loosened buildup that the first treatment dislodged.
2. For heavily soiled machines, a third treatment may be needed: each cycle clears more of the accumulated residue.
3. After the cleaning cycles, leave the door open: this lets the drum air out completely and prevents moisture from bringing odors back.

Scent and Sensitivty Concern

If skin irritation or respiratory sensitivity occurs, discontinue use right away. Running 1–2 empty hot water cycles will flush any remaining cleaning solution from the machine before washing clothes in it again.

A few things worth knowing about the formula:

1. Washing Machine Cleaner is made with all-natural, non-toxic, bleach-free ingredients. It is safe for your machine, your clothes, and your home — but individual sensitivities can vary, especially to fragrances.
2. The scent is intentionally light: strong enough to deodorize bad odors in the machine, but not designed to linger on clothes. If the fragrance is stronger than expected, the extra rinse cycles should clear it out.
3. The flush cycles serve double duty: they remove both residual cleaning solution and any lingering scent from the drum, gasket, and pipes.

Tablet not Dissolving

Tablet dissolution is almost always a water temperature issue — the tablet is designed to fully dissolve in hot water during a complete wash cycle.

Here’s what we recommend:

1. Select the hottest water temperature your machine offers. Cold or warm settings often aren’t enough to break the tablet down completely.
2. Run a full-length cycle. Quick or express washes may not give the tablet enough time to dissolve.
3. Place the tablet directly in the drum. The detergent dispenser can restrict water flow and prevent proper dissolution.
4. If residue remains, run one additional empty hot rinse cycle. This will flush out any remaining cleaning solution. The residue is safe — it will not damage your machine or transfer to clothes on the next load.

Residue Flakes on Clothes

Tablet dissolution is almost always a water temperature issue — the tablet is designed to fully dissolve in hot water during a complete wash cycle.


1. Run one additional empty hot cycle without a tablet: this flushes out any buildup that was loosened during the first cleaning cycle.
2. Treat flakes as a first-use cleanup sign: this is common when the machine has significant residue built up inside.
3. Wipe any visible residue from the gasket or drum after the flush cycle: that helps remove anything the machine loosened but did not fully wash away.
4. Resume regular laundry only after the extra flush cycle: that gives the machine a clean reset before the next load.

This usually happens because the cleaner is breaking loose buildup that has been sitting inside the washer for a long time. One extra hot flush cycle is normally enough to clear it out.

Left Residue

Here's what usually causes residue after treatment with Pee Buster — it's almost always an application issue, and it's completely reversible.

Odor Returned

1. Re-apply with heavy saturation. Use enough product to soak through to the same depth the urine reached. The area should be wet to the touch, not just damp on the surface.

Hook the tip onto the rim.

. Once the opening is hooked onto the rim, gently stretch the soft tip down and around the hearing aid body. Take your time and make sure the opening is sitting evenly around the rim.

Device Won't Charge

I’m sorry to hear that you’re having trouble charging your Oricle Hearing Aids. Here are several potential causes along with their solutions that may help you:

1.
Dirty Charging Contacts

: If the charging contacts on the hearing aids or inside the charging case are dirty, they may not charge properly. Please clean the charging contacts using the cleaning tool provided to remove any debris that might be interfering with the connection.

2.
Depleted Charging Case Battery:

If the charging case itself has run out of battery, the hearing aids won’t charge. Make sure to fully charge the charging case to ensure it has enough power to charge your hearing aids.

3.
Incorrect Placement:

It’s essential to place the hearing aids in the correct slots of the charging case. Ensure that the left (L) hearing aid is in the left (L) charging slot and the right (R) hearing aid is in the right (R) charging slot.

4.
Unpowered Adapter:

If the charging case is not charging, it might be because the adapter is not powered. Please ensure that the adapter is plugged in and receiving power. If everything looks good, try unplugging the charging cable and replugging it.

5.
Charging Cable Issues:

Sometimes, the charging cable itself may be faulty. If you have another compatible charging cable available, please try using that to see if it resolves the issue.
